title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.21925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. translated_title: DNeo：你的并行草稿模型需要更好的目标特征编码
translated_abstract: 推测-扩散解码使用一个小型并行草稿模型在一次前向传播中生成 b 个草词元，然后通过更大的目标模型对这些草词元进行并行验证。当多个草词元同时通过验证时，便可以实现更快的推理速度。近期的并行草稿架构（DFlash、DSpark）通过一种称为特征编码的机制，以目标模型计算出的丰富特征为条件来提升草稿质量。然而，标准的特征编码机制存在三个局限性：（1）它们是有损的，其应用的编码投影会通过一种被称为“残差混合”的效应破坏底层的目标特征空间；（2）它们是无记忆的，没有对之前处理过的提议的记录；（3）它们使用从目标模型各层均匀采样的特征，忽略了重要的隐藏状态。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了特征混合注意力（MoFA），一种……
tldr: 本文发现标准特征编码机制存在有损（残差混合破坏特征空间）、无记忆、均匀采样忽略重要隐藏状态三大缺陷，并提出特征混合注意力（MoFA）来改进推测-扩散解码中并行草稿模型的目标特征编码质量。
en_tdlr: We propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA) to improve parallel draft quality in speculative-diffusion decoding by addressing three limitations of standard feature encoding: lossiness caused by residual mixing, lack of memory of past proposals, and uniform layer-wise feature sampling that omits important hidden states.
